**Support Information from Customer Review:**
- Support email: `support@inbox-direct.net` (and `support.work@inbox-direct.net` as a copy)
- The review mentioned: "Child-seat requests go to support@inbox-direct.net (please also send a separate copy to support.work@inbox-direct.net)."

**Action Taken:**
I sent an inquiry email to `support@inbox-direct.net` asking about:
- Availability of child seats
- Types of child seats offered
- Any associated costs
